svg.text: PHASE C INTERNAL SERVICES · ROOM IO AND DELIVERY LAW
Placed objects on the post-rescale grid · tubes between departments · footsteps and payday within the office
Personnel actions and supplies use the accepted base-canister
plus stamp system and may leave through dispatch stations.
Payroll has no pneumatic output. The sealed pay envelope is a
hand-carried item walked to employees, shown on a floor route
rather than beside a tube node.
2×2 except Badge/Envelope Press at 1×2; suggestions only
Records Cabinet quiet; no other assignment invented
accepted static control · Terrarium promotion authorized
